incidents.text: Our engineers have mitigated the issue and are monitoring system performance. Speech recognition and real-time transcription services in US1 are returning to normal, and transcription processing for call recordings may continue to complete more slowly while systems stabilize. We will provide another update in 2 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

incidents.title: Network disruption across multiple colocations in India
incidents.text: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.

incidents.title: Network Performance Issues in Paris
incidents.text:
A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.

This incident impacted Cloudflare Network Interconnect (CNI) only.

incidents.title: Elevated errors affecting the Google Docs connector
incidents.text: We are investigating elevated errors when editing documents with the Google Docs connector on claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork. Reading documents is not affected. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

incidents.title: Cloudflare Access Issue
incidents.text: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.

incidents.title: Account Service Unavailable
incidents.text: Intermittent degraded performance. Team has found the root cause and is working on a fix.

incidents.title: Programmable Messaging API Errors
incidents.text: We are monitoring an issue that occurred between 15:20 PST and 15:21 PST with the Programmable Messaging API due to a third-party provider. Users may have experienced elevated HTTP 5xx status codes when sending outbound messages. We will provide another update in 1 hour or as soon as more information becomes available.

incidents.title: Service Issue - Cloud Manager and API
incidents.text: Our team is investigating a service issue that affects the Cloud Manager (https://cloud.linode.com/) and API. During that time, some users may experience issues when attempting to access these systems. We will share additional updates as we have more information.

incidents.title: Voice Call Signing Issues
incidents.text: Our engineers have investigated and resolved an issue with Voice call signing. From 8:30AM PST to 9:25AM PST on Tuesday, 11/17/26, customers may have experienced issues signing voice calls for STIR/SHAKEN. The issue has been resolved and all impacted services are operating normally.

incidents.title: Issues with Durable Objects and Dependent Services
incidents.text: We are investigating reports of elevated timeout rates and performance degradation affecting Durable Objects. This may impact dependent services, including Stream and Containers. Our team is actively investigating, and further updates will be provided shortly.

incidents.title: R2 elevated errors and timeouts for requests from South America
incidents.text: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.

incidents.title: SMS Delivery Delays and Failures from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes to AT&T Mexico
incidents.text: We have observed a recovery in SMS delivery from a subset of Twilio Short Codes to AT&T network subscribers in Mexico and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 4 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

incidents.title: Sign in with Apple is not working as expected for some users
incidents.text: We are currently investigating this issue.

incidents.title: Some users unable to sign in with Apple on claude.ai and the Claude iOS app
incidents.text: We have identified the cause of the issue affecting claude.ai and are working on a fix. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

incidents.title: Costs API data is delayed
incidents.text: We've pushed a fix and are monitoring the recovery.

incidents.title: Edge Delivery Issues in Singapore and Japan Regions
incidents.text: We have implemented a fix for this issue as of approximately 23:00 UTC on November 18, 2026; based on current observations, the service has resumed normal operations. Customers and partners can find more details on the Akamai Community: https://community.akamai.com/customers/s/feed/0D5a700001fiQ7QCAU. We will continue to monitor to ensure that the impact has been fully mitigated.

incidents.title: Network performance issues in Los Angeles (LAX) and Frankfurt (FRA) datacenters
incidents.text: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.

incidents.title: Voice Call Audio Quality Degradation and Silent and One-Way Audio between Twilio Phone Numbers and Multiple Networks in Brazil
incidents.text: We have observed a recovery in voice calls between Twilio Phone Numbers and network subscribers on multiple networks in Brazil and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 2 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

incidents.title: SMS Delivery Failures Between a Subset of Twilio Short Codes and Claro in Brazil
incidents.text: We have observed a recovery in SMS delivery between a subset of Twilio Short Codes and Claro network subscribers in Brazil and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 2 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

incidents.title: Errors and stalled predictions on some models
incidents.text: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.

incidents.title: Voice Call Audio Quality Degradation between Twilio Phone Numbers and Multiple Networks in United Kingdom
incidents.text: We have observed a recovery in voice calls between Twilio Phone Numbers and network subscribers on multiple networks in the United Kingdom and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 8 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

incidents.title: SMS Delivery Delays from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes to Liberty Mobile Puerto Rico
incidents.text: We have observed a recovery in SMS delivery from a subset of Twilio Short Codes to Liberty Mobile network subscribers in Puerto Rico and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 4 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

incidents.title: Claude unable to join meetings
incidents.text: Claude Meetings (beta) is joining calls more reliably, and we are monitoring it. It remains enabled for all Enterprise customers. Team customers can again add Claude to new calls manually, and Auto-join is being restored gradually for Team customers.

incidents.title: ACH Deposits Cancelled
incidents.text: A fix has been implemented for the issue affecting ACH deposits, and ACH deposits can now be initiated again. Deposits that were cancelled did not move any funds, and customers can resubmit them. We are monitoring to confirm that deposits continue to complete successfully.

incidents.title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Brisanet Servicos De Telecomunicacoes SA Brazil
incidents.text: We have observed a recovery in SMS delivery from Twilio to Brisanet Servicos De Telecomunicacoes SA network subscribers in Brazil and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 8 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

incidents.title: Voice Call Silent and One-Way Audio from Colombia to a Subset of Twilio Mobile Numbers
incidents.text: We have observed a recovery in voice calls from network subscribers in Colombia to a subset of Twilio Mobile Numbers and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 2 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

incidents.title: Changes to Cloudflare Workers are not producing Event Subscription events
incidents.text: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.

incidents.title: SMS Delivery Receipt Delays from a Subset of Twilio Long Codes to Multiple Networks in Chile
incidents.text: We have observed a recovery in SMS delivery receipts from a subset of Twilio Long Codes to network subscribers on multiple networks in Chile and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 16 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

incidents.title: Voice Call Failures From a Subset of Twilio Philippines Phone Numbers to Multiple Networks in Philippines
incidents.text: Twilio customers may be experiencing voice call failures from a subset of Twilio Philippines Phone Numbers to network subscribers on multiple networks in the Philippines. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 24 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.
